nom: Good Molecules Vitamin C Serum with Oryzanol

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced oiliness and a more matte, even complexion, with one longtime cystic-acne sufferer describing near-clear skin after extended use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several describe the serum as drying, tightening, or flaking on their skin, while others with dry or mature skin report improved hydration and softness over time.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination/sensitive skin reports smoother texture and improved rough patches with no irritation.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: some report no irritation, breakouts, or pilling and good tolerance (including with rosacea or acne-prone sensitive skin), while others report tightness, dryness, or pilling.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as mature or older report reduced fine lines, increased radiance, and hydration, with one long-term user (2 years) noting visible results on mature skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin type is not clearly represented; oily-skin reviewers report their skin behaving more like normal skin after use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging report reduced appearance of fine lines and increased radiance/glow; no dissent noted specific to aging complaints.
concerns.dehydration: Mixed reports: several reviewers say the product leaves skin feeling hydrated, soft, and smooth over time, while a substantial number describe the opposite — tightness, dryness, and a mask-like drying sensation, especially in the first minutes after application.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin report no irritation or redness triggered by the product; one review notes some sensitizing/irritation when first introduced before skin adjusted.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe compromised comfort — tightness, stinging, or a mask-like feeling — while others explicitly note no irritation or adverse reaction, including on tretinoin-sensitized or rosacea skin.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report fading of dark spots, post-acne marks, and discoloration with continued use over weeks to months; no dissent found specifically on spot-fading claims.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report fewer breakouts and fading acne scars, including one long-term user describing resolution of years of cystic acne; no reviewers report new breakouts caused by the product, though several report cosmetic pilling rather than blemish issues.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the product leaves skin matte and less oily, with one describing a shift from oily to normal-feeling skin; no dissenting reports of increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Affordable relative to other vitamin C serums

extraits.texte: I purchased this serum and have been using it wvery morning for the last month and not only have I seen 0 progress or change for my skin, it pills like CRAZY. Initially after putting the product on, my face is very sticky. After it dries, it completely flakes and peels off in tiny pills all over my face - I hate the feeling. I tried wearing it alone and it still peeled, I tried wearing it hnder makeup, it peeled and took my foundation with it. I just cannot get it to work. Not impressed.

extraits.titre: This product pills and can be sensitizing
extraits.texte: I love this product, but it can be sensitizing in the beginning. When I first started this, I didn't know why my skin was irritated and more dry, but I realized it was this new product. I had to restart and slowly integrate it into my routine by applying it every other day and increasing usage slowly. That was fine for me, but a heads up for other people who are more sensitive that me. It also pills a lot for me no matter how much I try to alter the application process. Again, it's okay for the most part, but when I'm applying make up, it makes me make up patchy and unpleasant. Overall, I love this product though. It has made my skin so much brighter! I will keep using this, but I hope formulation changes so it doesn't pill so much.

I keep reading reviews about pilling and flaking,but I didn't experience that when using it. I actually really enjoyed the product and used the entire bottle without issue. I layered it with other Good Molecules products, as well as other brands. I do tend to have more dry skin and I'm older (34) with two kids. So, I really think it just depends on the individual's skin more than anything.

extraits.texte: I was a little stumped because it felt like the vitamin c serum from this brand was no longer working. So I decided to try this one and im SO glad I did!!! My skin ate this serum right uppp. It does go on a bit more tacky and much less liquidy like the other serum but in almost two months my skin was essentially clear AND my oiliness was so under control! I used to be a really oily gal but with this brand it felt much less and like I had normal skin. With this serum my skin looked good AND MATTE. I was so happy and not all expecting it! My skin felt so smooth, brighter and more even. Ultimately I went back to the regular vitamin c serum because I miss it being more liquidy and idk if its because of this serum, but when I switched back my skin ate up the regular vitamin c serum even more! Within the second month of using that, my skin was completely clear and even toned. No dark spots, no nothing. I literally almost cried because as someone who used to have horrible cystic acne, painful bumps, sores and dark spots everywhere, these two serums help heal almost decades of it in almost less than two years. Genuinely, thank you good molecules!!!

The Vitamin C Serum with Oryzanol has been a great addition to my skincare routine. As someone in my late 50s with medium brown skin, I love how it enhances my skin's radiance and reduces the appearance of fine lines. I use it twice daily with other Goid Molecules products for oily, aging skin. Oryzanol offers multiple benefits, including UV protection, anti-aging properties, moisturizing, antioxidant effects, and skin tone improvement. It helps keep my skin hydrated and balanced, even during winter. Overall, I'm very pleased with the results!

This is the first vitamin c serum I've ever used that doesn't irritate my sensitive, acne prone, rosacea skin! I love that you start to see results pretty quickly too. I've been using it for a few weeks and notice that my skin is smooth and some dark spots are fading.
This Vitamin C is lovely. It doesn't pill or leave a film, but I feel its definitely helped with my acne scars. I've already finished a tube.
